var ErrBranchConflict error // ErrBranchConflict means a selected message is no longer in the topic the request expected (someone else branched it first): nothing changed.
var ErrChannelLimit error // ErrChannelLimit means the organisation cannot create another channel.
var ErrChannelNameTaken error // ErrChannelNameTaken means the organisation already has a channel with that name.
var ErrChannelNotFound error // ErrChannelNotFound means the channel does not exist in the caller's organisation, including when it exists in another one.
var ErrInvalidBody error // ErrInvalidBody wraps a body that breaks ValidateMessageBody or, as ErrUnknownReference, references a member posting cannot find.
var ErrInvalidBranch error // ErrInvalidBranch means the request itself is unusable: no messages, too many, a repeated one, no destination or two, or the source as destination.
var ErrInvalidChannelImage error // ErrInvalidChannelImage means the key is outside the bundled set.
var ErrInvalidChannelName error // ErrInvalidChannelName wraps a name that breaks ValidateChannelName.
var ErrInvalidPostCursor error // ErrInvalidPostCursor means the page cursor is invalid or ahead of committed events.
var ErrInvalidTopicName error // ErrInvalidTopicName wraps a name that breaks ValidateTopicName.
var ErrMessageNotFound error // ErrMessageNotFound means no message has the requested key in the caller's organisation and channel, including when the message exists in another scope.
var ErrPinLimit error // ErrPinLimit means a new pin would exceed MaxChannelPins.
var ErrPostKeyReused error // ErrPostKeyReused means the author already sent another body or channel under the key; Send returns that stored message with it and writes nothing.
var ErrPostKeyTaken error // ErrPostKeyTaken is Writer.InsertMessage's signal that the author's key is already stored; Send turns it into a repeat and never returns it.
var ErrQuoteNotFound error // ErrQuoteNotFound means the quoted message is not in the poster's organisation and channel: unknown, another organisation's and another channel's are the same error, so the answer reveals none of them.
var ErrTopicNameTaken error // ErrTopicNameTaken means the channel already has a topic with that name, ignoring case.
var ErrTopicNotFound error // ErrTopicNotFound means the topic does not exist in the given organisation and channel, including when it exists in another channel or organisation.
var ErrUnknownReference error // ErrUnknownReference wraps ErrInvalidBody for a body referencing a member the URL's organisation's directory did not return.

  func (*Posting).Send(ctx context.Context, m github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/org.Membership, channelID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, s Send) (Sent, error) // Send posts a composer submission.
type Quote struct // Quote is a message's copy of an earlier message's text in the same channel (decision 38).
  field MemberID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID
  field MessageID *github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID // MessageID is the original, or nil once it is deleted.
  field Text string
type ReadRangeWriter interface // ReadRangeWriter adds a range to a member's read set, including their persisted join prefix.
  func (ReadRangeWriter).Merge(ctx context.Context, organizationID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, channelID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, memberID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, joinedEventSeq int64, lo int64, hi int64) error
type ReadRangeWriterIn func(github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/platform/postgres.Tx) ReadRangeWriter // ReadRangeWriterIn binds read-state writes to branching's transaction.
type ReadStore interface [embeds PinReader] // ReadStore is conversation's reads in the caller's snapshot: the channel reads are scoped by organisation, the others by organisation and channel.
  func (ReadStore).GetChannel(ctx context.Context, organizationID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, id github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID) (Channel, error) // GetChannel returns a channel of the organisation, or ErrChannelNotFound.
  func (ReadStore).GetMessage(ctx context.Context, organizationID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, channelID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, eventSeq int64) (Message, error) // GetMessage returns the channel's message at eventSeq, or ErrMessageNotFound when the scoped key is absent.
  func (ReadStore).GetMessages(ctx context.Context, organizationID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, channelID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, ids []github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID) ([]Message, error) // GetMessages returns the requested IDs of the channel only, newest first; missing or out-of-scope IDs are omitted.
  func (ReadStore).GetTopic(ctx context.Context, organizationID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, channelID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, id github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID) (Topic, error) // GetTopic returns a topic of the channel, or ErrTopicNotFound.
  func (PinReader).ListChannelPins(ctx context.Context, organizationID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, channelID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID) ([]PinnedMessage, error)
  func (ReadStore).ListChannels(ctx context.Context, organizationID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID) ([]Channel, error) // ListChannels returns the organisation's channels by name, then ID.
  func (ReadStore).ListMessagesAfter(ctx context.Context, organizationID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, channelID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, topicID *github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, after int64, limit int32) ([]Message, error) // ListMessagesAfter returns at most limit messages of the channel newer than event_seq after, oldest first, only of topicID when it is set.
  func (ReadStore).ListMessagesBefore(ctx context.Context, organizationID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, channelID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, topicID *github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, before *int64, limit int32) ([]Message, error) // ListMessagesBefore returns at most limit messages of the channel older than event_seq before (the latest when before is nil), newest first, only of topicID when it is set.
  func (ReadStore).ListTopics(ctx context.Context, organizationID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, channelID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, limit int) ([]Topic, error) // ListTopics returns at most limit topics of the channel: the default first, then by name ignoring case, then by ID.
  func (ReadStore).LocateMessage(ctx context.Context, organizationID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, id github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, limit int32) (Location, int, error) // LocateMessage returns where the organisation's message is now and how many newer messages its topic holds, counted up to limit, or ErrMessageNotFound.
  func (ReadStore).LookupTopics(ctx context.Context, organizationID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, channelID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, topicIDs []github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID) (map[github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID]Topic, error) // LookupTopics resolves the requested topics of the channel in one batch, so a page costs one topic query rather than one per message.
type ReadStoreIn func(github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/platform/postgres.Snapshot) ReadStore // ReadStoreIn binds conversation's reads to the caller's snapshot.
type Reader struct // Reader owns page, sidebar, single-message and batch snapshots across conversation, org, identity and unread through factories bound to the same read-only snapshot.
  func (*Reader).Around(ctx context.Context, m github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/org.Membership, channelID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, topicID *github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, around int64) (ChannelPage, error) // Around reads the older page holding event_seq around, with context on both sides, in the same snapshot as Page.
  func (*Reader).Locate(ctx context.Context, m github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/org.Membership, id github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID) (at Location, err error) // Locate finds where a message of the member's organisation is now, for its URL (decision 36).
  func (*Reader).Many(ctx context.Context, m github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/org.Membership, channelID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, ids []github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID) (entries []Entry, err error) // Many reads a bounded batch of the channel's messages, such as a move's or one to quote, with their quotes and directories in one snapshot.
  func (*Reader).Members(ctx context.Context, m github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/org.Membership, channelID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, after *github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID) (page MembersPage, err error) // Members reads a bounded channel membership page.
  func (*Reader).One(ctx context.Context, m github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/org.Membership, channelID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, eventSeq int64) (entry Entry, err error) // One reads one message, its author names and topic in a read-only snapshot.
  func (*Reader).Overview(ctx context.Context, m github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/org.Membership, channelID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, topicID *github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, before *int64, around int64) (ChannelPage, error) // Overview reads the page Page or Around would (around when it is positive, else before) and the channel's bounded pins across all its topics, with their topics and author and pinner names, in the page's snapshot, so the pins and the page cursor agree.
  func (*Reader).Page(ctx context.Context, m github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/org.Membership, channelID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, topicID *github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, before *int64) (ChannelPage, error) // Page reads channel or topic history with the snapshot's event cursor, including older pages with a before bound.
  func (*Reader).Pins(ctx context.Context, m github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/org.Membership, channelID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID) ([]Pin, error) // Pins reads the bounded current pins without exposing their display sequence.
  func (*Reader).ReadPins(ctx context.Context, m github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/org.Membership, channelID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID) (state PinsSnapshot, err error) // ReadPins reads only the channel's bounded pins, current topics and names in one read-only snapshot.
  func (*Reader).Sidebar(ctx context.Context, m github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/org.Membership, channelID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, topicID *github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID) (sidebar SidebarSnapshot, err error) // Sidebar reads lists and counts in an independent read-only repeatable-read snapshot, including its organisation event sequence, without history or directories.
type Reference struct // Reference is a referenced member's current names.
  field DisplayName string
  field Handle string
func RouteMoved(payload []byte) (github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, []github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, error) // RouteMoved is messages.moved's realtime.Router: the channel and both topics, so a view of either sees the move.
func RoutePinsChanged(data []byte) (github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, []github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, error) // RoutePinsChanged routes channel-wide invalidations across every topic.
func RoutePosted(payload []byte) (github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, []github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, error) // RoutePosted is message.posted's realtime.Router: the channel and, unless the payload is legacy, the posting-time topic.
type Send struct // Send is one composer submission.
  field Body string
  field Cursor *int64 // Cursor is the page's applied-and-shown cursor; nil reads only the new message.
  field Key *IdempotencyKey // Key makes a repeated send return the first message; nil posts without it.
  field Quote *github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID // Quote is a message of the channel to quote whole (decision 38), or nil.
  field Topic *github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID
  field UnknownMember string // UnknownMember stands in the quote's text for a member the quoted chat_v1 message references and the directory did not return.
type Sent struct // Sent is what a send produced.
  field Message Message // Message is the new message or, on a repeat or with ErrPostKeyReused, the author's stored one, wherever branching has moved it since.
  field Repeat bool // Repeat reports that an earlier send with the key stored Message.
  field Topic github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID // Topic is the requested place, resolved before inserting or replaying, which a repeat's composer and typing stay on.
type SequenceRange struct // SequenceRange contains message sequences from Lo inclusive to Hi exclusive.
  field Hi int64
  field Lo int64
type SidebarCounter interface // SidebarCounter is the counts-only extension used by independent recounts.
  func (SidebarCounter).ReadCounts(context.Context, github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/org.Membership, github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, []github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, []github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, *github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID) (PageCounts, error) // ReadCounts returns both count maps without computing first unread.
type SidebarSnapshot struct // SidebarSnapshot holds fresh sidebar lists and explicit counts, including zero.
  field ChannelCounts map[github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID]int64
  field Channels []Channel
  field Current Channel
  field SnapshotSeq int64
  field Topic *Topic
  field TopicCounts map[github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID]int64
  field Topics []Topic
type SnapshotRunner interface // SnapshotRunner runs page/sidebar snapshots, One and Many (decision 26): the use case owns the read boundary, and the stores and directories only bind to the Snapshot they are given, so every read sees the same committed state.
  func (SnapshotRunner).InSnapshot(ctx context.Context, fn func(github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/platform/postgres.Snapshot) error) error // InSnapshot runs fn in a new read-only, repeatable-read transaction, returning fn's error as is.
type TextSegment struct // TextSegment is one piece of a chat_v1 body's text extraction: literal text, or a member reference that the caller resolves when it uses the text, so no name is stored and a rename never leaves stale text.
  field Member github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID
  field Reference bool // Reference marks a segment that names Member; its Text is empty.
  field Text string
type Topic struct // Topic is a named conversation inside a channel, identified by ID.
  field ChannelID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID
  field CreatedAt time.Time
  field ID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID
  field IsDefault bool
  field Name string
  field OrganizationID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID
type TopicReadCandidates interface // TopicReadCandidates supplies unread message bounds without exposing storage.
  func (TopicReadCandidates).Ranges(ctx context.Context, organizationID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, channelID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, topicID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, cursor int64, prefix int64, floor int64, readSet []SequenceRange) ([]SequenceRange, error) // Ranges returns [previous + 1, next) for the topic's unread messages shown through cursor, using whole-channel neighbours (0 or message + 1 if absent).

  func (TopicReader).GetTopic(ctx context.Context, organizationID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, channelID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, id github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID) (Topic, error)
type TopicUnread interface // TopicUnread counts messages using supplied read state, never foreign tables.
  func (TopicUnread).Count(ctx context.Context, organizationID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, channelID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, prefix int64, topics []github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, floors []int64, readSet []SequenceRange, selected *github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID) (map[github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID]int64, int64, error) // Count returns per-topic counts capped at 100 and the selected topic's uncapped first unread sequence (zero if none).

type Topics struct // Topics runs the topic lookups for a member resolved by org.
  func (*Topics).Get(ctx context.Context, m github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/org.Membership, channelID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, topicID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID) (Topic, error) // Get returns a topic of the channel in the member's organisation, or ErrTopicNotFound.
type TxRunner interface // TxRunner runs channel creation, posting, branching and pinning (decision 26): the use case owns the boundary, the writers only bind to the Tx they are given.
  func (TxRunner).InTx(ctx context.Context, fn func(github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/platform/postgres.Tx) error) error // InTx runs fn in a new transaction.
type TypedBodyProof [36]byte // TypedBodyProof records the normalized typed body's byte length (big-endian uint32) and SHA-256 digest.
func ValidateChannelImage(key string) error // ValidateChannelImage accepts a bundled key, or empty for the ID-based default.
func ValidateChannelName(value string) (string, error) // ValidateChannelName returns a trimmed NFC name of 1–80 printable Unicode code points.
func ValidateMessageBody(value string) (string, error) // ValidateMessageBody normalizes line endings and trims the whole body source text.
func ValidateTopicName(value string) (string, error) // ValidateTopicName returns a trimmed NFC name of 1–80 printable Unicode code points, the same rule as channel names (docs/domain/topics.md).
type Writer interface // Writer is posting's and branching's reads and writes in the caller's transaction, on validated values.

  func (Writer).GetTopic(ctx context.Context, organizationID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, channelID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, id github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID) (Topic, error) // GetTopic returns a topic of the channel, or ErrTopicNotFound.
  func (Writer).InsertMessage(ctx context.Context, organizationID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, channelID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, topicID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, memberID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, body string, eventSeq int64, key *IdempotencyKey, proof TypedBodyProof, quote *Quote) (Message, error) // InsertMessage inserts posting's message at the sequence the caller took, into a topic it resolved in the same transaction first (GetDefaultTopic or GetTopic).
  func (Writer).InsertNotice(ctx context.Context, organizationID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, channelID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, topicID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, memberID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, body string, eventSeq int64) (Message, error) // InsertNotice inserts branching's notice like InsertMessage but maps no error, so a failure there stays a server error (R2 on #502).
  func (Writer).KeyedMessage(ctx context.Context, organizationID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, memberID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, key IdempotencyKey) (Message, error) // KeyedMessage returns the author's message stored with the key in the organisation, or ErrMessageNotFound.
  func (Writer).LastMessageBefore(ctx context.Context, organizationID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, channelID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, seq int64) (int64, error) // LastMessageBefore returns the channel's previous message sequence, or zero.
  func (Writer).MoveMessages(ctx context.Context, organizationID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, channelID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, fromTopicID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, toTopicID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, messageIDs []github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, movedEventSeq int64) (int64, error) // MoveMessages moves the given messages still in the source topic of the channel to the destination, recording the move sequence, and returns how many moved.
  func (Writer).QuotedMessage(ctx context.Context, organizationID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, channelID github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID, id github.com/tkakkie/ribbitto/internal/kernel.ID) (Message, error) // QuotedMessage returns the channel's message with the ID, or ErrQuoteNotFound when it is missing or in another organisation or channel.
